name: AI access window and approval
description: Window > AI Access… and AIAccessCenter, which runs the approval flow on AppKit: the -AIAccessDemoRequest launch hook, the approval sheet begun on the main window (NSWindow.beginSheet), the Controlled by chip as a titlebar accessory, and the window listing and revoking grants. It runs on FakeAIAccess until afterglow-mcp MC-10's live channel replaces it; MC-12 built it and MC-13 holds its render budget.
